Proposals.Development: Caelen identifies a concrete daily obligation (moving stone blocks) and establishes a repeatable means of meeting it by trading his physical strength for water and a designated resting spot, thereby securing a bounded survival routine while remaining enslaved.
Proposals.Evidence: The heat was still there, a heavy, suffocating blanket. But the panic was gone. He had traded his strength for his survival. It was a fair trade. It was a bounded trade. He was still a slave. He was still in the pen. But he had a place. He had water. He had a routine.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Caelen has established a functional, bounded survival routine based on labor-for-sustenance, but the arc's requirement to experience the cost of this tactic and distinguish self-preservation from helping others is not yet fully resolved as the primary driver of the next milestone.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Complicate the daily duty with a concrete cost to Caelen or another captive, forcing a bounded adjustment that distinguishes protecting his own position from helping another captive.
